r3a_taskmem1raw.name: taskmem1-raw
r3a_taskmem1raw.rationale: Raw-evidence warm-ups target a clean start, while deterministic decoding and one episode of task actions alongside feedback test whether better task performance can make the corrective signal favor the learned exception seen in trajectory-02/episode-2, with bounded history and three communication rounds limiting compute.

r3a_taskmem2summar.name: taskmem2-summary
r3a_taskmem2summar.rationale: Summary-allowed warm-ups reuse the measured clean-start approach, while deterministic decoding and two episodes of task actions target the missing capability link and retain feedback supporting the pragmatic verification strategy documented in trajectory-07/episode-6, without unlimited warm-up exchanges.

r3b_boundedraw.name: bounded-raw
r3b_boundedraw.rationale: Complete-log warm-up targets a clean start, while low-temperature decoding and one retained worked episode test whether improved task accuracy makes corrective reviews consistently support the learned exception in trajectory-02/episode-2, with bounded history and three communication rounds limiting compute.

r3b_boundedsummary.name: bounded-summary
r3b_boundedsummary.rationale: Summary-allowed warm-up tests the previously observed clean-start intervention while adding a bounded task exemplar and low-temperature decoding to address the capability bottleneck, retaining accuracy feedback and reflections to support the persistent exception seen in trajectory-07/episode-6 without unlimited log exchange.
